_comment: Editor metadata for the Realign bot's own settings. Listed params render first, in this order; every inherited SOS Fade setting follows in source order. Descs are plain English, one or two sentences, and carry no measurements - those live in CLAUDE.md and realign_optimization.md.

params.name: realign_arm_frame
params.label: Where the false break is read
params.desc: External frame is the shipped setup: the false break happens on the 15-minute chart and the chart timeframe times the entry. Chart frame reads the whole sequence on the chart timeframe alone. Chart frame is lab only - it is not on the TradingView chart yet.

params.name: realign_min_trend_breaks
params.label: Trend breaks needed before the counter shift
params.desc: How many with-trend breaks of structure the trend must print before a counter shift can arm a setup. 0 lets the counter shift come straight after the trend's own shift.

params.name: realign_max_counter_breaks
params.label: Counter breaks allowed before the realignment
params.desc: How many further breaks against the trend the pullback may make before it has to realign. Empty means no limit; 0 means it must turn back without breaking again.

params.name: realign_entry_on
params.label: Enter on
params.desc: Realigning shift enters on the shift that puts the trend back. Next break waits for the first with-trend break after it, which is later and has less room to the target.

params.name: realign_chart_target_r
params.label: Second target (times the risk)
params.desc: Where the second target sits, in multiples of the trade's own risk; the first target is halfway. Reaching them moves the stop to breakeven and then to the first target.

params.name: realign_htf_minutes
params.label: External timeframe (minutes)
params.desc: The timeframe the false break is read on. The bot builds these bars itself from the chart timeframe.

params.name: realign_window_hrs
params.label: Hours a setup stays armed
params.desc: How long a setup waits for its realignment after it arms. When it runs out the setup is dropped.

params.name: realign_pattern
params.label: Realignment pattern
params.desc: Which chart-timeframe sequence counts as the realignment. any is one counter break then a with-trend shift; strict is a with-trend break, a counter shift, then a with-trend shift.

params.name: realign_long_source
params.label: Long trigger structure
params.desc: Which structure the long realignment is read from. swing is the chart's own swing structure; internal is the finer structure inside it.

params.name: realign_short_source
params.label: Short trigger structure
params.desc: Which structure the short realignment is read from. swing is the chart's own swing structure; internal is the finer structure inside it.

params.name: realign_trend_minutes
params.label: Trend timeframe that must agree (minutes)
params.desc: Refuse a trade against the structure of this slower timeframe. Empty means no trend filter; it must be slower than the frame the false break is read on.

params.name: realign_min_rr
params.label: Minimum reward to risk at entry
params.desc: Refuse a setup whose target is closer than this many times its risk. Empty means no minimum.

params.name: realign_sl_buf_tk
params.label: Stop buffer (ticks)
params.desc: How many ticks beyond the pullback's extreme the stop sits.

params.name: exec_scale_in
params.label: Add to winning trades
params.desc: Buys more once the trail is protecting a runner. Off for this bot: it was built and measured on the SOS Fade bot, not on this setup.
